annotations.title: Get the full report for a site

description: The full report of one of the user's sites as one Markdown file: the newest scan (score, each issue with its fix and example pages), the fix files, AI prompt checks, Google index status, page 2 queries, long questions, Bing AI citations, internal link suggestions, the local business check, the local coverage maps and the page drafts. A section with no data, or a section that the plan does not have, is named at the end with the reason. Use it when the user asks for everything about a site, or asks you to fix the site: read the file, then make the changes in the project. Read-only. It can take up to 30 seconds.
name: get_site_report
title: Get the full report for a site
